taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-03, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-03, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-03, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-03 comprises four layers with resistivities increasing monotonically with depth:

- Layer 1: 177.8 Ω·m (0–13.27 m)
- Layer 2: 265.8 Ω·m (13.27–16.67 m)
- Layer 3: 1064.5 Ω·m (16.67–25.48 m)
- Layer 4: 2584.7 Ω·m (basement, unterminated)

Applying the curve-type rule to each triplet:
- Layers 1-2-3: r1 < r2 < r3 → A
- Layers 2-3-4: r2 < r3 < r4 → A

This yields an "AA" sequence, consistent with a steadily increasing resistivity profile (typical of a resistive basement overlain by progressively more resistive layers). The on-file classification of "AA-type" matches the computed sequence, confirming the curve type is correctly labeled for this station. No discrepancy was found between the resistivity data and the stated curve type.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
